body:
Data USA API research for occupation cooks age and gender. Source queries:
https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/cubes/pums_5
Main query underlying chart:
https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=pums_5&drilldowns=Gender,Age,Year&include=Workforce%20Status:true;Detailed%20Occupation:352010&locale=en&measures=Record%20Count,Total%20Population&filters=Record%20Count.gte.5
Filtered high ages maybe:
https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=pums_5&drilldowns=Gender,Age,Year&include=Workforce%20Status:true;Detailed%20Occupation:352010;Age:85,86,87,88,89&locale=en&measures=Record%20Count,Total%20Population&filters=Record%20Count.gte.5
Individual aggregated years high ages/gender useful:
https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=pums_5&drilldowns=Gender,Year&include=Workforce%20Status:true;Detailed%20Occupation:352010;Age:85,86,87,88,89&locale=en&measures=Record%20Count,Total%20Population&filters=Record%20Count.gte.5
